summary: Municipal Infrastructure Maintenance (110-4013) counted as a tax in Other taxes
detail: The budget documents label it Municipal Infrastructure Maintenance (about $62-197K a year); the city's audits report it as Telecommunications tax, and as a tax. Before 2026-10-22 it was treated as an excluded fee.

summary: budget documents call this Municipal Infrastructure Maintenance; counted as a tax (decided 2026-10-22), as the audit presents it
detail: Shown as its own group in the audit-basis tables and counted in totals.

summary: Telecom Tax Rebate (01-5-110-4013) sits in the expense block, is not in the printed revenue total, and is left out of the series
detail: At most $10,783 a year. It is the rebate of the 110-4013 tax; open item whether to treat it as an offset. Shares an object code with the revenue line, hence flow contra_expense.

summary: Health Insurance Reimbursement is in the expense block and not in the printed revenue total
detail: Kept as a contra_expense account so it cannot be confused with revenue.

summary: Printed 01-5-330-4940 through FY2019, 01-4- in FY2020-23, 01-5- again in FY2024
detail: Same line, second account segment flips between 4 and 5; account keys therefore ignore it (entity.json key_segments). Also affects 310-4940 and 310-4950.

summary: City prints 01-4-1104114 (missing hyphen) for Real Estate Tax to Developer
detail: Printed in the FY2026 budget and mirrored in the FY2027 file; normalised by entity.json typo_fixes.

summary: $26,000 Forestry revenue line printed with no label or account number
detail: Inserted by an add_row override (01-4-340-UNLABELED). The FY2026 audit's Grants = documents' 436,000 + 26,000, so it is a grant, not a tax.
evidence: budget FY2026 page image; audit FY2026

summary: Local motor fuel tax is inside the audit's Grants line FY2020-FY2025, its own line only in FY2026
detail: Audit Grants budget equals the documents' grants + motor fuel to the dollar, so motor fuel is left out of every audit-basis year to keep the series continuous.

summary: hotel/motel + auto rental + cannabis; local motor fuel tax excluded in every year (audit reports it inside Grants FY2020-25)
audit reports sales and use combined; later audits report them separately (summed here)
detail: Sales and use are summed in every year so the series is continuous.

summary: Audit replacement tax is net of the distribution to pensions
detail: Budget side: 110-4120 + 140-4120 minus the pension distribution 110-4121. Budget-document actuals for the pension distribution look like budget copies in FY2019-20 and FY2022-25, so audited actuals are the better series.

summary: FY2014 audit sales tax is net of a $35,000 developer rebate
detail: The only comparable group-year where audit original budget differs from the budget documents' adopted budget (134 of 135 match). Later audits do not net developer rebates.

summary: FY2025 document's FY2024 utility tax column holds the FY2023 values, not the adopted budget
detail: FY2024 utility $2,160,000 per the audits (original and final). FY2025 document restates 1,092,591 / 846,396 / 148,176 (the FY23 values) vs the adopted 1,100,000 / 925,000 / 135,000. Also 150-4940: 158,478 vs 158,480. budget_prior_doc differs from adopted; adopted (own-document) is used.
evidence: audit FY2024 original and final budgets

summary: FY2026 document's FY2025 Audit and IMRF levy columns differ from the adopted budget
detail: Audit 20,039 vs 20,000 and IMRF 65,088 vs 65,000 in the FY2026 document; the audits show the own-document (earlier) figures were adopted. The same column also shows Heritage Days (110-4901) 31,781 vs 0, not a tax.

summary: Buchanan Street Strolls (01-4-615-*) is omitted from the city's printed fund total in some columns
detail: FY2021, FY2022's FY21 columns, and the actual column of FY2023 and FY2024. Flagged not_in_printed_total; not a tax.

summary: City's printed FY2016 fund total is $1 off its own rows
detail: allow_diff override. Cent-rounding differences of $1-3 also occur in printed Actual totals.

summary: No FY2014 budget document extracted; FY2014 adopted figures come from document FY2015's prior-year column
detail: The FY2014 audit original budget agrees.

summary: Values corrected by eye against page images are recorded in data/belvidere_il/overrides/
detail: Each override row carries its reason. FY2021 needed 8; recurring OCR errors are a leading 1 read as 4 and 6 read as 8.
